## Qwen3.5-9B (multimodal)

`configs/sdft-qwen3.5-9b.yaml` targets `Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B` (early-fusion
multimodal, 262K-native context, hybrid Gated-DeltaNet attention). The trainer
auto-detects the multimodal class (`AutoModelForMultimodalLM`).

Multimodal capability is retained **by construction**: LoRA targets only the
language-trunk linears (`q/k/v/o_proj`, `gate/up/down_proj`,
`in_proj_qkv/z`, `out_proj`), so `model.visual.*` (vision encoder + merger)
stays byte-identical to the base checkpoint — verified: the saved adapter
contains zero vision-tower tensors. The reverse-KL-to-base teacher
additionally anchors text behavior against drift.

For fast Gated-DeltaNet kernels install:

```bash
pip install flash-linear-attention causal-conv1d
```

(without them transformers falls back to a slow torch implementation).
